title: Hillside post-and-beam house with a lower-level ADU
source: Preliminary design drawings: main, upper and lower level plans (1/8 inch = 1 foot), four elevations and 3D plan views.

stages.label: House
stages.line: The house on its hillside: a post-and-beam main floor with a planted roof, an upper floor box above it and a daylight lower level that opens to the back. Choose Explore to turn the model or go to a room.

stages.label: Entry side
stages.line: The entry side faces the street at the main floor: the garage door, the entry porch and a row of high transom windows. The lower level is under the ground here.

stages.label: Roofs
stages.line: The roofs lift away: two low flat roofs with deep overhangs, the main roof planted as a green roof around the upper floor, as drawn on the upper level plan.

stages.label: Upper floor
stages.line: The upper floor: a primary suite with an ensuite and laundry closet, an office or bonus room, a walk-in closet and the stair.

stages.label: Main floor
stages.line: The main floor: kitchen, dining and living room with tall glass to the back deck, a pantry, laundry and mudroom by the garage, the foyer and stair, and an office or guest suite with a bath.

stages.label: Lower level
stages.line: The lower level ADU, dug into the slope and open to the back patio: a flexible living room, a kitchenette, two bedrooms and a bath, with unfinished storage and mechanical rooms.
